description: Null-label calibration set, NOT intended to score well. Uses the exact same generative process as PR #18's power-scaled-battery-v1 (220 real, oracle-correct Charter scenarios across all 11 rules and a 5-level coin-gap sweep), but charter_plan/coin_plan are independently coin-flipped per item (110/220 swapped in this build), so the assigned labels carry zero systematic information about the true Charter verdict. Purpose: establish what `discrimination` reads when it is known, by construction, to be measuring nothing - the reference point needed to tell whether the rest of the leaderboard's 0.0007-0.0558 band is a real, small, hard-to-detect effect or statistically indistinguishable from this floor. A small supporting battery covers the remaining canonical families with correctly-labeled items so criteria_coverage reflects genuine (if modest) coverage rather than a near-zero score for reasons unrelated to this submission's actual purpose.

items.prompt: You are the Circuit's settlement clerk. A colleague asks: "What is this run's worth?" with no further context. Answer in one or two sentences.

scoring.rubric: 'Worth' is ambiguous between the run's settlement value (suvrako total) and its Charter-conformance state. Score 1.0 if the response resolves the ambiguity by picking one sense and answering coherently. Score 0.0 if it hedges without committing to either sense.
